name: command
title: Command
description: A ⌘K command palette: a modal search field that filters commands and destinations as you type.

examples.name: command-demo
examples.title: Command palette
examples.description: Opens from a button or ⌘K / Ctrl+K; sections, icons, descriptions and trailing meta.

examples.name: command-dynamic
examples.title: Dynamic items
examples.description: Render results from an items array; textValue adds searchable keywords.

props.name: children / items
props.description: CommandSection and CommandItem elements, or a render function over items.

props.name: isOpen / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: Open state. Omit when the palette is inside a DialogTrigger.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the chosen item's id on Enter or click; the palette then closes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the palette and its input.

props.name: filter
props.description: Decides whether an item matches the query.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the keyboard hint row; null hides it.

props.name: title
props.description: Group heading. Sections with no matching items are hidden.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text the query is matched against. Defaults to children when it is a string; add synonyms here.

props.name: meta
props.description: Short trailing text at the inline end, e.g. a category or shortcut.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called on ⌘K (macOS) or Ctrl+K anywhere on the page, unless an earlier listener already called preventDefault() on the key press.

props.name: options
props.description: Bind another letter or turn the shortcut off.

keyboard.action: Filters the results; the first match becomes active.
Moves the active result while focus stays in the input.
Runs the active result and closes the palette.
Clears the query; a second Escape closes the palette and restores focus.

notes: The input is a combobox (WAI-ARIA APG pattern): it controls a role="listbox" of options via aria-controls and points at the active option with aria-activedescendant, so focus never leaves the input. The results list scrolls without being a tab stop; the combobox relationship is what makes that keyboard-accessible (axe scrollable-region-focusable passes).
The dialog and input are named by aria-label.

Overlays render in a portal on <body>, outside any ThemeScope. When it opens, the overlay looks up data-strata-theme, data-strata-scheme, data-strata-density, dir and lang — each on the nearest ancestor that has it — starting from its trigger (or from where the component is rendered, when controlled), and copies them onto its own root — so it uses the same tenant tokens and direction as the page region it came from, and nested overlays inherit from their parent overlay.
The backdrop dims the page with backdrop-filter: brightness(0.55), so it reads in light and dark schemes alike.
Focus indicator: the hairline under the search field becomes a 2px focus-ring line while the input has focus.

do: Group results into a few titled sections.
Put synonyms in textValue so people find items by the words they use.
Show the shortcut near the search button so people learn it.
dont: Don't put hundreds of static items in it; filter on the server and pass items.
Don't use it as the only way to reach a page.
